summary: 50 units reviewed. Overall careful draft: tokens, splits and identifications are sound (sarṣapa, taṇḍula, yava, bilva, kola standard; madana=wax correctly hedged as probable). Real errors: unit 51 states the conjectural 'four palas' as fact; unit 71 gender of vṛddhyā. Measure equations (66-70, 84-85): the English/Hindi copula is accepted as unavoidable; supplied 'one' in English patched to the article; Hindi 'एक' kept as an owner decision. Elliptical lists 73-83 are fine (colon, no added verb). Unit 72 'tenth part' is the plain reading. Units 98-100 are colophon/dedication, rightly noted; unit 99 Kalpasiddhisthāna is probably the genuine title. Unit 90 needs a human decision.
glossary_suggestions: Measure equations (nominal sentences 'six X = Y'): copula are/is/हैं/है allowed; English uses the article 'a', not 'one'; Hindi 'एक' as article (OPEN for owner).

Conjectural joins/restorations of numbers or unit names (e.g. ch08 u51 catuṣpalam, u71 māṣaka-śāṇa) must be hedged in the translation (English 'on a conjectural reading', Hindi 'सम्भवतः' or 'अनुमानित पाठ के अनुसार').
vṛddhi f.; pala: no gender in gram.
kavalagraha = 'mouthful-grasp'; madana = wax (probable) when used as a comparison for sneha residue; śīta/phāṇṭa Hindi 'ठण्डा अर्क / गरम अर्क'.
Aṣṭāṅga Saṅgraha part 5 is titled Kalpasiddhisthāna in the colophon.
